rootCauseOneLine: Volta stamps _VOLTA_TOOL_RECURSION=1 on the bb-app it launches; bb forwards it to the daemon and sanitizeInheritedChildProcessEnv (packages/process-utils/src/index.ts:188) only strips BB_*/NODE_ENV, while the daemon swaps PATH for the login-shell PATH that puts Volta's node/npm/npx shims back in front, so the shims see the guard, skip platform resolution and fail with "Node is not available" (also breaking $BB_CLI and bb, both #!/usr/bin/env node).
proposedFix: Strip _VOLTA_TOOL_RECURSION in sanitizeInheritedChildProcessEnv (packages/process-utils/src/index.ts), the single choke point for every bb-spawned child (provider bridges, terminals, git, plugin hosts, script automations); one-hunk diff at /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1545/repro/proposed-fix.diff. Mirrors Volta's own `volta run` (removes the same var because a new command is a new context). No wire change, no protocol bump. Verified: repro test flips from fail to pass and the same Claude Code turn prints v24.19.0 while the daemon still carries the guard. Optional hardening: also drop it in bb-app createDaemonEnv/createServerEnv.
caveats: Reproduced on Linux with Volta 2.0.2 installed into a scratch VOLTA_HOME and a wrapper $SHELL so the daemon's login-shell PATH probe yields "Volta shims first, no other Node" (the reporter's mac/zsh setup is not available). The one simulated element is injecting _VOLTA_TOOL_RECURSION=1 into the dev instance's env instead of launching bb-app through a real Volta package shim; a real Volta package shim (probe package installed via `npm i -g` under Volta) was shown to set exactly that variable. The worktree HEAD had drifted to a108fa7ef at start; I pinned it to 16ceb3a54 before all repro runs (none of the 5 intervening commits touch the relevant files). The worktree now contains the proposed fix and the repro test (uncommitted).
